value.rationale: The 1/k tail is a genuine critical boundary between finite-mean singleton survivors and Sibuya-type nontrivial one-positive limits. Multiple survivor conditioning recovers a universal, normalized multiplicity law, giving meaningful predictions for rare observations of large heavy-tailed groups. The canonical closed-form, all-e likelihood-ratio order and sharp finite-TV calibration quantify the observation bias, beyond a routine one-step asymptotic.
